title: Die Hochzeit des Mönchs
summary: "Die Hochzeit des Mönchs" by Conrad Ferdinand Meyer is a novella published in 1884. The story follows Astorre, a monk who faces an agonizing conflict between his religious vows and worldly life. When family tragedy strikes, his dying father pressures him to abandon the monastery and marry to save their lineage. Torn between duty and devotion, Astorre makes choices that lead him deeper into moral transgression. Set within a frame narrative where Dante tells the tale at a medieval court, this work explores the devastating consequences of betraying one's true nature.
